Mission Local reported that the Mission Economic Development Agency (MEDA) was in contract to buy the four-story, 1914 brick building at 2901 16th St., two blocks east of 16th Street BART, and convert it into 62 permanently affordable homes. The plans included 54 studios, six one-bedroom units and two single-room occupancy units. The ground floor’s hair salons and restaurants would remain, and current tenants could stay or move out during rehabilitation. The purchase depended on city approval of a loan.
